description: Hi! I’m Matheus, a game dev from Brazil and indie studio founder. I recently shipped Sery: Into the World of Myths, a 2D pixel-art platformer on Steam. Strong technical background; I love game design and experimenting with new mechanics like computer vision and voice input. Join T-Minus to build a small, polished game we actually finish! Looking for: 2D artists (pixel art/animation), sound designers/composers, game designers/writers and programmers. Motivation over experience! 🚀
